items.evidence: The Financial Performance Goal considered for our annual incentive bonus targets is EPS, adjusted for special items and impairments.
The Operational Performance Goals considered for our annual incentive bonuses
Valero's achievements in the areas of health, safety, and environmental;
Using the Mechanical Availability scoring from the industry-standard Solomon Associates survey
Valero's achievements in cost management and expense control.
Included in these goals for #was a qualitative capital-based performance measure assessed by the Compensation Committee through return on capital employed.
These measures establish the maximum level of funding for the bonus program.
Shares of Common Stock are earned with respect to vesting performance shares only upon Valero's achievement of TSR objectives
Additional shares of Common Stock may be earned based on the accumulated value of dividends paid
Restricted stock targets represent the remaining # of each executive officer's long-term incentive target
